items.title_zh: 也门城市遭胡塞武装围困，饮用水供应日益减少
items.summary: 这篇 NPR 报道讲述了也门第三大城市塔伊兹在胡塞武装围困下饮用水极度短缺的人道危机。文章通过当地居民的具体事例，呈现了水、燃料和食品价格飞涨如何相互叠加，把普通家庭推向生存边缘。报道还解释了塔伊兹的战略地位，以及胡塞武装为何难以完全攻占该城。文章语言平实但信息密集，适合学习如何用英文描述人道危机和因果链条。

vocab.example_en: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
vocab.example_zh: 也门城市遭胡塞武装围困，饮用水供应日益减少

vocab.example_en: Drinking water has been scarce for over a decade in Taiz, but the problem has reached crisis levels in recent weeks as Iran-backed Houthi rebels besiege Yemen's third-largest city.
vocab.example_zh: 塔伊兹的饮用水短缺已持续十多年，但最近几周，随着伊朗支持的胡塞武装围困这座也门第三大城市，问题已升级到危机程度。

vocab.example_en: Families are rationing every drop.
vocab.example_zh: 家家户户都在精打细算每一滴水。

vocab.example_en: Fuel is also in short supply, making it difficult to maintain basic services such as hospitals and sanitation, which compounds the public health risks.
vocab.example_zh: 燃料也供应不足，使得医院和卫生等基本服务难以维持，这进一步加剧了公共卫生风险。

vocab.example_en: Houthis strangle Taiz, cut off residents' access to wells
vocab.example_zh: 胡塞武装扼住塔伊兹的咽喉，切断居民取用井水的通道

vocab.example_en: Yemen descended into civil war in 2014, when the Houthis seized much of the country's north, including the capital of Sanaa, and forced the internationally recognized government into exile.
vocab.example_zh: 也门在2014年陷入内战，当时胡塞武装夺取了该国北部大片地区，包括首都萨那，并迫使国际社会承认的政府流亡海外。

vocab.example_en: War-related damage to Taiz's aging water infrastructure magnified the pressures of population growth and frequent droughts that led to shrinking supplies of groundwater.
vocab.example_zh: 战争对塔伊兹老化供水设施的破坏，放大了人口增长和频繁干旱带来的压力，导致地下水供应不断萎缩。

vocab.example_en: The truckers that have managed to ferry water into Taiz have in some cases tripled their rates to make the perilous journey.
vocab.example_zh: 设法把水运进塔伊兹的卡车司机，有些把运费涨到了三倍，以补偿这趟危险的行程。

vocab.example_en: He used to earn money hauling construction material, but that income is no longer steady and his family is barely scraping by.
vocab.example_zh: 他过去靠搬运建筑材料挣钱，但这份收入已不再稳定，一家人勉强维持生计。

vocab.example_en: Leaving Taiz is not an option for al-Shahid because the costs of travel and renting a home in another province are prohibitive.
vocab.example_zh: 对沙希德来说，离开塔伊兹不是选项，因为旅途费用和在另一个省租房住的成本高得令人却步。

items.title_zh: 特朗普在密歇根为迈克·罗杰斯站台——还不忘点评妮琪·米娜的臀部
items.summary: 这篇《卫报》报道聚焦特朗普在密歇根州集会上为共和党参议员候选人迈克·罗杰斯助选时，再次对他人身体发表粗俗言论，此次对象是歌手妮琪·米娜的臀部，并回溯了他此前对俄亥俄州参议员乔恩·赫斯特德臀部的评论。文章还穿插了密歇根选情胶着、奥巴马对特朗普的讽刺、以及特朗普关于美加贸易战的表态。语言风格讽刺冷峻，适合学习如何用英文报道政治人物的争议言论，并掌握外刊中常见的描述性词汇和复杂句式。

vocab.example_en: Donald Trump reiterated his apparent love for buxom bums during a rally in Michigan on Sunday where he encouraged the crowd to compliment rapper Nicki Minaj’s behind.
vocab.example_zh: 周日，唐纳德·特朗普在密歇根州的一场集会上再次表达了他对丰满臀部的明显喜爱，并鼓励人群赞美说唱歌手妮琪·米娜的臀部。

vocab.example_en: Donald Trump reiterated his apparent love for buxom bums during a rally in Michigan on Sunday where he encouraged the crowd to compliment rapper Nicki Minaj’s behind.
vocab.example_zh: 周日，唐纳德·特朗普在密歇根州的一场集会上再次表达了他对丰满臀部的明显喜爱，并鼓励人群赞美说唱歌手妮琪·米娜的臀部。

vocab.example_en: Trump’s cheeky comments about Minaj’s derriere came as he explained his recent observation on the Republican Ohio senator Jon Husted’s rear end.
vocab.example_zh: 特朗普对米娜臀部的轻佻评论，是在他解释自己最近对俄亥俄州共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德臀部的观察时发表的。

vocab.example_en: The Michigan race between Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed remains neck and neck as both political parties scramble for control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections.
vocab.example_zh: 随着两党在即将到来的中期选举中争夺国会控制权，罗杰斯与民主党人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州的选情仍然不相上下。

vocab.example_en: The Michigan race between Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed remains neck and neck as both political parties scramble for control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections.
vocab.example_zh: 随着两党在即将到来的中期选举中争夺国会控制权，罗杰斯与民主党人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州的选情仍然不相上下。

vocab.example_en: But he couldn’t resist his purported other favorite topic.
vocab.example_zh: 但他忍不住又提起了据称他另一个最爱的话题。

vocab.meaning_zh: 非正式地，私下说说（不供发表）
vocab.example_en: “I said: I looked at his ass, and I’ve never done that with a man before. It’s true. Off the record, women yes, men no, OK.”
vocab.example_zh: “我说：我看了他的屁股，我以前从没对男人这么做过。这是真的。私下说，女人可以，男人不行，好吧。”

vocab.example_en: Trump then shouted out Minaj, who the New York Post said was donned in “head-to-toe Gucci” today.
vocab.example_zh: 特朗普随后向米娜致意，《纽约邮报》称她今天“从头到脚穿的都是古驰”。

vocab.example_en: Trump’s comments come amid criticism of his language style, which some have likened to grotesquerie.
vocab.example_zh: 特朗普的这些言论出现之际，他的语言风格正受到批评，一些人将其比作怪诞荒唐。

vocab.example_en: “Canada has been ripping off the US for years. I had to do it,” Trump said of tariffs during the rally.
vocab.example_zh: “加拿大多年来一直在占美国的便宜。我不得不这么做，”特朗普在集会上谈到关税时说道。

items.title_zh: 也门城市遭胡塞武装围困，饮用水供应日益减少
items.summary: 这篇 NPR 报道讲述了也门第三大城市塔伊兹在胡塞武装围困下饮用水和燃料严重短缺的困境。文章通过具体家庭案例、援助组织数据和分析人士观点，展现了围困对平民生活的多重打击。报道结构清晰，包含大量数据、引语和因果分析，适合学习如何用英文描述人道主义危机，也是练习外刊长难句和固定搭配的好材料。

vocab.example_en: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels.
vocab.example_zh: 也门城市遭胡塞武装围困，饮用水供应日益减少。

vocab.example_en: Iran-backed Houthi rebels besiege Yemen's third-largest city in their escalating conflict with government forces.
vocab.example_zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞叛军在不断升级的冲突中围困了也门第三大城市。

vocab.example_en: Families are rationing every drop.
vocab.example_zh: 家家户户都在省着用每一滴水。

vocab.example_en: Fuel is also in short supply, making it difficult to maintain basic services such as hospitals and sanitation, which compounds the public health risks.
vocab.example_zh: 燃料也供应短缺，使医院和卫生等基本服务难以维持，这加重了公共卫生风险。

vocab.example_en: Houthis strangle Taiz, cut off residents' access to wells.
vocab.example_zh: 胡塞武装扼住塔伊兹的咽喉，切断居民取用井水的通道。

vocab.example_en: Yemen descended into civil war in 2014, when the Houthis seized much of the country's north.
vocab.example_zh: 也门在2014年陷入内战，当时胡塞武装夺取了该国北部大片地区。

vocab.example_en: The Houthis ramped up their advance on Taiz last month, after a lightning-fast capture of the port city of Mokha.
vocab.example_zh: 胡塞武装上月加强了对塔伊兹的攻势，此前他们闪电般攻占了港口城市莫卡。

vocab.example_en: The truckers that have managed to ferry water into Taiz have in some cases tripled their rates to make the perilous journey.
vocab.example_zh: 那些设法将水运进塔伊兹的卡车司机，有些将运费提高了两倍，以补偿这趟危险旅程。

vocab.example_en: He used to earn money hauling construction material, but that income is no longer steady and his family is barely scraping by.
vocab.example_zh: 他过去靠搬运建筑材料赚钱，但这份收入已不再稳定，他家勉强维持生计。

vocab.example_en: Leaving Taiz is not an option for al-Shahid because the costs of travel and renting a home in another province are prohibitive.
vocab.example_zh: 离开塔伊兹对沙希德来说不是选项，因为旅费和在另一个省租房的价格高得令人却步。

items.title_zh: 特朗普取消部分对加拿大关税，以助缅因州陷入苦战的苏珊·柯林斯
items.summary: 文章报道特朗普政府以“更好地服务公共利益”为由，取消了对加拿大部分农产品和加工设备的关税，此举被视为对缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯的选举助攻。柯林斯正面临与民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊的激烈选战，这场选举可能决定参议院控制权归属。文章分析了关税对缅因州经济的冲击、加美贸易战背景，以及民主党对特朗普此举政治动机的批评。

vocab.meaning_zh: 给某人送去一场胜利；让某人获益
vocab.example_en: Donald Trump dropped some of the US’s tariffs on Canada on Friday to “better serve the public interest” the White House said, handing a win to Susan Collins.
vocab.example_zh: 白宫表示，唐纳德·特朗普周五取消了对加拿大部分商品的关税，以“更好地服务公共利益”，这给苏珊·柯林斯送去了一场胜利。

vocab.meaning_zh: 陷入困境的；饱受批评或挑战的
vocab.example_en: …handing a win to Susan Collins, the embattled Republican senator for Maine…
vocab.example_zh: ……给缅因州陷入苦战的共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯送去了一场胜利……

vocab.meaning_zh: 翻转对……的控制权；夺取控制权
vocab.example_en: …a tight re-election campaign that will help determine whether Democrats can flip control of Congress.
vocab.example_zh: ……一场激烈的连任竞选，这将有助于决定民主党能否翻转对国会的控制权。

vocab.example_en: Collins announced that the exemptions would apply to nine agricultural products…
vocab.example_zh: 柯林斯宣布，豁免将适用于九种农产品……

vocab.example_en: …that are “unavailable from American suppliers or cannot be replaced without incurring significant expense”.
vocab.example_zh: ……这些材料“无法从美国供应商处获得，或者替换它们将招致巨额费用”。

vocab.example_en: “President Trump is further refining the scope of the July 20 and September 8 actions to better serve the public interest…”
vocab.example_zh: “特朗普总统正在进一步调整7月20日和9月8日行动的范围，以更好地服务公共利益……”

vocab.meaning_zh: 胜负难料的局面；胶着的竞争
vocab.example_en: The race is crucial for the Democratic party’s hopes of flipping control of the chamber, and is so far considered a toss-up.
vocab.example_zh: 这场竞选对民主党翻转参议院控制权的希望至关重要，而且到目前为止被认为胜负难料。

vocab.meaning_zh: 触动敏感神经；引起强烈反应
vocab.example_en: The trade war between Canada and Maine has touched a nerve in the state, which relies heavily on commerce with Canada.
vocab.example_zh: 加拿大与缅因州之间的贸易战触动了该州的敏感神经，该州严重依赖与加拿大的商业往来。

vocab.meaning_zh: 遭受打击；受到负面影响
vocab.example_en: Many of the industries most entrenched in the state’s history – such as logging, lobstering and fishing – were expected to take a hit after Trump’s tariff announcements this year.
vocab.example_zh: 该州历史上最根深蒂固的许多产业——如伐木业、龙虾捕捞业和渔业——预计在特朗普今年宣布关税后将遭受打击。

vocab.meaning_zh: 抓住（机会、话题等）大做文章；利用
vocab.example_en: Jackson has frequently seized on this line of attack since replacing Graham Platner on the Democratic ticket.
vocab.example_zh: 杰克逊自取代格雷厄姆·普拉特纳成为民主党候选人以来，经常抓住这一攻击线大做文章。

items.title_zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿希望将职业生涯延续到2030年代初，以便参加非洲大奖赛
items.summary: 本文报道汉密尔顿希望坚持比赛到2030年代初，以参加将在卢旺达举行的非洲大奖赛。文章介绍F1与卢旺达的十年协议及赛道尚未建成的情况，也呈现人权组织对“体育洗白”的批评。汉密尔顿回应称应谦逊看待问题、增加对非洲的教育，并提到殖民主义遗留。最后一段交代安东内利有望夺得首个F1年度冠军的条件。

vocab.meaning_zh: 专门建造的；为特定用途而建的
vocab.example_en: Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s.
vocab.example_zh: 上周，F1确认卢旺达将主办非洲大奖赛，此前双方已就该赛事在一座专门建造的赛道上举行达成了一项为期10年的协议，首场比赛定于2030年代初举行。

vocab.example_en: It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.
vocab.example_zh: 该赛事计划在首都基加利以南25英里的布格塞拉的一条赛道上举行，该赛道尚未建成，这标志着F1自1993年在南非基亚拉米举行比赛以来首次重返非洲大陆。

vocab.example_en: Hamilton has been championing a race in Africa for some time.
vocab.example_zh: 汉密尔顿一段时间以来一直在倡导在非洲举办比赛。

vocab.example_en: The 41-year-old is understood to be currently contracted with Ferrari until the end of the 2027 season, and speaking before this weekend’s US Grand Prix he said he would like to continue racing for at least another four years in order to make it to the meeting in Rwanda.
vocab.example_zh: 据了解，这位41岁的车手目前与法拉利的合同持续到2027赛季结束；在本周末美国大奖赛前发言时，他表示希望至少再继续比赛四年，以便赶上在卢旺达举行的这场比赛。

vocab.meaning_zh: 成功赶上；设法到达/参加
vocab.example_en: The 41-year-old is understood to be currently contracted with Ferrari until the end of the 2027 season, and speaking before this weekend’s US Grand Prix he said he would like to continue racing for at least another four years in order to make it to the meeting in Rwanda.
vocab.example_zh: 据了解，这位41岁的车手目前与法拉利的合同持续到2027赛季结束；在本周末美国大奖赛前发言时，他表示希望至少再继续比赛四年，以便赶上在卢旺达举行的这场比赛。

vocab.meaning_zh: 体育洗白（借举办体育赛事改善形象、转移对不良记录的关注）
vocab.example_en: “A 10-year grand prix ‘presented by Visit Rwanda’ is a sportswashing prize for the Rwandan authorities,” said Felix Jakens, Amnesty UK’s head of campaigns.
vocab.example_zh: “一场由‘Visit Rwanda’冠名的十年大奖赛，对卢旺达当局来说是一份体育洗白的奖品，”国际特赦组织英国分部运动负责人费利克斯·贾肯斯说。

vocab.meaning_zh: 转移对……的注意力；使人不去关注
vocab.example_en: Rwanda is buying into the world’s biggest sports to polish its image and deflect from its appalling human rights record.
vocab.example_zh: 卢旺达正投入世界最大体育项目，以美化形象、转移人们对其骇人的人权记录的关注。

vocab.example_en: That rings hollow if F1 shrugs off who it is partnering with.
vocab.example_zh: 如果F1对自己与谁合作不以为意，那这话听起来就很空洞。

vocab.example_en: That rings hollow if F1 shrugs off who it is partnering with.
vocab.example_zh: 如果F1对自己与谁合作不以为意，那这话听起来就很空洞。

vocab.example_en: Rwanda’s authorities are prolific in arbitrary detention, torture and the repression of free speech.
vocab.example_zh: 卢旺达当局在任意拘留、酷刑和压制言论自由方面行为频仍。

items.title_zh: 海伦·海恩斯遇袭后，工党、联盟党及中立议员对家中和工作场所安全感到担忧
items.summary: 文章报道了澳大利亚议员海伦·海恩斯遇袭后，多名联邦政界人士在安全简报会上向警方和情报机构表达了对威胁扩大的担忧。安全机构将审查议员住宅和办公室的安全措施，但大规模审查目前不太可能。许多议员自掏腰包安装安全设备，认为后座议员资源不足。文章还提到针对公职人员的骚扰和威胁报告数量上升，并引用了多位议员和官员的言论。

vocab.example_en: Security agencies will review safety precautions for MPs’ homes and offices
vocab.example_zh: 安全机构将审查议员住宅和办公室的安全预防措施

vocab.meaning_zh: 提出（想法、建议等）供讨论
vocab.example_en: ideas being floated including a new committee on MPs’ safety
vocab.example_zh: 提出的想法包括成立一个新的议员安全委员会

vocab.example_en: motions of condolence for Haines
vocab.example_zh: 对海恩斯的哀悼动议

vocab.meaning_zh: 中立议员（席位）（不属执政党或反对党的议员）
vocab.example_en: Renewed calls from the crossbench for reforms to question time
vocab.example_zh: 中立议员再次呼吁改革质询时间

vocab.example_en: numerous backbenchers said they felt under-resourced
vocab.example_zh: 许多后座议员表示他们感到资源不足

vocab.example_en: may see all politicians as a homogenous group
vocab.example_zh: 可能把所有政客看作一个同质的群体

vocab.meaning_zh: 被激起的；被动员起来的
vocab.example_en: People are getting activated now because they see us as part of the government.
vocab.example_zh: 人们现在被激起来了，因为他们把我看作政府的一部分。

vocab.example_en: the AFP recorded 951 reports of harassing and threatening behaviour against office holders
vocab.example_zh: 澳大利亚联邦警察记录了951起针对公职人员的骚扰和威胁行为报告

vocab.example_en: A number of politicians asked to speak anonymously to discuss reflections from the briefings.
vocab.example_zh: 一些政客要求匿名发言，讨论简报会上的反思。

vocab.meaning_zh: 护柱（用于阻止车辆进入的短柱）
vocab.example_en: If it makes my team feel better and safer to have bollards out the front, I’m happy
vocab.example_zh: 如果在门前设置护柱能让我的团队感觉更好、更安全，我很乐意

items.title_zh: 轻声细语的大卫·波科克雄心勃勃——但他首先希望政客们“加倍”友善
items.summary: 这篇《卫报》报道聚焦澳大利亚独立参议员大卫·波科克在全国新闻俱乐部的首次演讲。这位前橄榄球明星明确表示无意竞选总理，而是提出要打造一种新的社区政治联盟，并推动三项关键政策改革：天然气出口税、数据中心征税和政治透明度改革。文章还分析了他如何以温和而有力的沟通方式影响全国舆论，以及他对现有两党制的挑战。这篇报道语言生动、结构清晰，适合学习外刊中的政治报道词汇和复杂句式。

vocab.example_en: He’s six foot tall and full of muscle, but David Pocock’s real strength is often sounding like the most sensible, commonsense voice in the room.
vocab.example_zh: 他身高六英尺，肌肉发达，但大卫·波科克真正的力量往往在于他听起来像是房间里最明智、最合乎常理的声音。

vocab.meaning_zh: 说话轻声细语的；语调温和的
vocab.example_en: No matter how much some people might like the softly spoken senator to have more say in federal politics.
vocab.example_zh: 无论有些人多么希望这位说话轻声细语的参议员在联邦政治中有更多发言权。

vocab.meaning_zh: （比赛）终场哨；这里比喻政治生涯的结束
vocab.example_en: But before the full-time whistle on his parliamentary career, the former rugby star has a match against his toughest opponent yet: the two-party system.
vocab.example_zh: 但在这位前橄榄球明星的议会生涯终场哨响之前，他还有一场对阵迄今为止最强劲对手的比赛：两党制。

vocab.example_en: He called for a higher calibre of politics after the alleged attack on the independent Indi MP, Helen Haines.
vocab.example_zh: 在独立议员海伦·海恩斯遭到疑似攻击后，他呼吁提升政治的水准。

vocab.meaning_zh: 在……上加倍努力；更加坚定地做……
vocab.example_en: He said parliament must “meet this [alleged] attack on you by doubling down on the values you represent”.
vocab.example_zh: 他说议会必须“通过加倍践行你所代表的价值观来回应这次（据称的）攻击”。

vocab.example_en: A 5% levy on datacentres to capture more benefits from the AI boom.
vocab.example_zh: 对数据中心征收5%的税，以从人工智能热潮中获取更多收益。

vocab.meaning_zh: 既得利益集团；特权阶层
vocab.example_en: Transparency reforms to shine a light on lobbyists, secret meetings with politicians and vested interests.
vocab.example_zh: 透明度改革，以揭露游说者、与政客的秘密会面以及既得利益集团。

vocab.meaning_zh: 贫困潦倒的；一无所有的
vocab.example_en: Pocock recounted the moment a woman sat sobbing in his office, so destitute on the miserable jobseeker allowance that she ate dog food because she hadn’t eaten meat in so long.
vocab.example_zh: 波科克讲述了一位女子坐在他办公室里哭泣的场景，她靠着微薄的求职者津贴生活，穷困潦倒到吃狗粮，因为她太久没吃过肉了。

vocab.meaning_zh: 重击；这里指对……征收重税或使其受损
vocab.example_en: I don’t understand why we’re slugging everyday Aussies and yet we’re happy to export gas for free.
vocab.example_zh: 我不明白为什么我们要让普通澳大利亚人承受重负，却乐于免费出口天然气。

vocab.example_en: Not that Pocock is angling to win that position himself.
vocab.example_zh: 这并不是说波科克自己在谋求赢得那个职位。

items.title_zh: 美国给予乌克兰和苏丹移民暂缓遣返待遇
items.summary: 本文报道美国国土安全部在乌克兰和苏丹移民的临时保护身份即将到期之际，宣布暂不终止其保护，超过10万人得以暂时免于被遣返。文章梳理了政策背景：特朗普政府此前已终止13个国家逾百万人的临时保护身份，但最近对萨尔瓦多人也采取了类似的“延期但不定期限”做法。文章引用支持移民的公益组织负责人和主张减少移民的智库专家的对立观点，并指出这一决定出台于中期选举前两周，移民政策将成为选票考验。文章信息密集、引语丰富，适合练习新闻报道中的被动语态、插入语和态度表达。

vocab.meaning_zh: 暂缓、缓刑；（处罚的）暂时解除
vocab.example_en: More than 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan can stay in the United States without immediate risk of deportation, the Department of Homeland Security said, in what amounts to a temporary reprieve after their right to stay in the country was set to expire on Monday.
vocab.example_zh: 美国国土安全部表示，来自乌克兰和苏丹的超过10万人可以留在美国，暂时没有立即被遣返的风险；在他们留美的权利原定于周一到期之后，这实际上相当于一次暂缓。

vocab.example_en: Temporary protected status was set to end on Monday for about 101,000 Ukrainians and 1,800 Sudanese.
vocab.example_zh: 约10.1万名乌克兰人和1800名苏丹人的临时保护身份原定于周一终止。

vocab.example_en: Until then, the department said in a written statement, Ukrainians and Sudanese in the US covered by those temporary measures “retain protection”.
vocab.example_zh: 国土安全部在一份书面声明中说，在那之前，受这些临时措施覆盖的在美国的乌克兰人和苏丹人“保留保护”。

vocab.example_en: The DHS did not respond to a question about whether they can keep their work permits, but TPS generally allows people to work while their protections remain in effect.
vocab.example_zh: 国土安全部没有回应他们能否保留工作许可的问题，但TPS通常允许人们在保护仍然有效期间工作。

vocab.example_en: The decision marks another incident where the Trump administration, which has previously sought to end these temporary protections from deportation and send people back to their home countries, has allowed people covered by the temporary status to stay in the country but without giving any guidance as to how long.
vocab.example_zh: 这一决定标志着又一起这样的事件：特朗普政府此前曾试图终止这些免于遣返的临时保护并将人们送回本国，而这次却允许受临时身份覆盖的人留在美国，却没有给出任何关于能留多久的指引。

vocab.meaning_zh: 最后一刻的、临到最后才做的
vocab.example_en: Yuriy Boyechko, CEO of Hope For Ukraine, a non-profit that provides humanitarian aid in Ukraine and helps resettle newcomers in the US, described the government’s announcement as “last-minute patches”.
vocab.example_zh: “希望乌克兰”是一家在乌克兰提供人道援助、并帮助新到美国者重新安置的非营利组织，其首席执行官尤里·博耶奇科将政府的这一宣布形容为“最后一刻的补丁”。

vocab.meaning_zh: 获得永久居留权的途径
vocab.example_en: “It’s time for US to come up with some normal path to permanent residency for all these people,” Boyechko noted.
vocab.example_zh: 博耶奇科指出：“美国是时候为所有这些人拿出一个正常的获得永久居留权的途径了。”

vocab.meaning_zh: 无可争辩、不容置疑（cavil 指无谓的挑剔）
vocab.example_en: “It’s beyond cavil that both Sudan and Ukraine are experiencing ongoing armed conflict, and therefore the secretary is well within his authority to continue TPS for each of them.”
vocab.example_zh: “苏丹和乌克兰都在经历持续的武装冲突，这一点无可争辩，因此部长完全在其权限范围内继续为两国维持TPS。”

vocab.example_en: The Trump administration has already terminated TPS for more than 1 million people from 13 countries, including Venezuela, Haiti, Honduras, Nicaragua, Afghanistan and Syria.
vocab.example_zh: 特朗普政府已经终止了来自13个国家、超过100万人的TPS，包括委内瑞拉、海地、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、阿富汗和叙利亚。

vocab.example_en: Activists and a bipartisan group of lawmakers have been raising the alarm over the upcoming deadline for TPS to expire for Ukrainians, arguing that conditions remain unsafe for them to return home amid the war with Russia.
vocab.example_zh: 活动人士和一个两党议员团体一直就乌克兰人TPS即将到期的期限发出警告，认为在与俄罗斯的战争期间，他们回国的条件仍不安全。

items.title_zh: GLP-1 减肥药的副作用，至今仍未完全弄清
items.summary: 礼来与诺和诺德公布的数据显示，服用 GLP-1 类药物的超重和糖尿病人群，生物学年龄比服用安慰剂的同类人群年轻两到三岁，这让它被一些人称作“长寿药”。但与此同时，这类药物的副作用清单还在变长：胃肠道反应最常见，此外还与胰腺炎、胆结石有关，并有个案称会损伤视神经。围绕脱发、指甲异常的关联也在研究中，不过因果关系远未确立。作者特别提醒，儿童用药的数据尤其稀薄——而美国 8 至 11 岁儿童的处方量在六年间增长了 310 倍。

vocab.meaning_zh: 大量；一连串（外刊极高频，比 a lot of 正式）
vocab.example_en: This latest announcement comes after we've seen a raft of other benefits associated with taking these drugs.
vocab.example_zh: 这则最新消息之前，我们已经看到一连串与服用这类药物相关的其他益处。

vocab.example_en: Overweight and diabetic people who take GLP-1s have a biological age around two to three years younger than similar individuals who take a placebo.
vocab.example_zh: 服用 GLP-1 的超重者和糖尿病患者，其生物学年龄比服用安慰剂的同类人群大约年轻两到三岁。

vocab.meaning_zh: 抑制；压制（情绪或生理机能）
vocab.example_en: So far, GLP-1 agonist drugs—which repress hunger—have been approved for treating diabetes, chronic kidney disease, and obesity.
vocab.example_zh: 迄今为止，能够抑制饥饿感的 GLP-1 激动剂类药物已获批用于治疗糖尿病、慢性肾病和肥胖症。

vocab.example_en: The most common side effects are gastrointestinal—nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and constipation.
vocab.example_zh: 最常见的副作用是胃肠道反应——恶心、呕吐、腹泻和便秘。

vocab.meaning_zh: 着手应对；努力弄懂（英式固定搭配，比 understand 更有“下功夫”的意味）
vocab.example_en: We're still getting to grips with the effects of weight-loss drugs on hair and nails, too.
vocab.example_zh: 对于减肥药对头发和指甲的影响，我们也仍在摸索。

vocab.meaning_zh: 不利的；有害的。adverse events 是药品监管领域的标准用语，即“不良事件”
vocab.example_en: This recommendation accounts for the lack of evidence on both benefits and the potential adverse events of the different medications.
vocab.example_zh: 该建议考虑到了以下证据的缺乏：不同药物所带来的益处，以及潜在的不良事件。

vocab.example_en: Still, pediatric side effects will be something to watch.
vocab.example_zh: 尽管如此，儿科副作用仍值得关注。

vocab.example_en: The organization explicitly says it does not recommend pharmacological treatment for kids under 10.
vocab.example_zh: 该组织明确表示，不建议对 10 岁以下儿童进行药物治疗。

vocab.example_en: I've heard people in the aging field describe GLP-1s as longevity drugs for a while now.
vocab.example_zh: 近来我常听衰老研究领域的人把 GLP-1 称为“长寿药”。

vocab.meaning_zh: （研究结果）不一致的；（评价）褒贬不一的。这个用法很多学习者不熟，外刊里极常见
vocab.example_en: Both companies dispute the claims. Research into the link is mixed.
vocab.example_zh: 两家公司均否认上述说法。关于二者关联的研究结论并不一致。
